messages:
maria-cs: FYI — Orbiton onboarding health check. We saw a ~45% token spend spike at their evening peak (region: us-west) with p95 latency creeping from 220ms -> 480ms. Suggest a small, low-risk pilot: micro-quant (per-channel int8 on dense layers) + hybrid routing that sends 20% traffic to a quantized variant during peak. Need eng + SE review before asking customer to opt-in. @matt-eng @olivia-se

matt-eng: Do we have a quick perf/cost delta and p95 breakdown by route? What's our rollback/acceptance criteria?

maria-cs: Quick numbers from last 48h (sample):
```
baseline: p95 220ms, cost/unit $0.0125
peak: p95 480ms, cost/unit $0.0183
expected micro-quant pilot: p95 ~260-300ms, cost/unit ~0.0135-0.014
```
Acceptance: if p95 on quant path <= 350ms and no functional regressions on canonical prompts -> proceed. If token-level quality drop > 3% on eval set -> rollback.

leo-research: For Orbiton's model family I recommend per-channel int8 with calibration on the first 10M tokens of their corpus. That setup typically gives ~30-40% throughput improvement with <2.5% BLEU/ROUGE-ish delta on our customer evals. Also add KV cache warming for session-heavy flows.

olivia-se: A couple notes from product side — Orbiton relies on structured JSON outputs for invoice parsing. We should run the smoke eval on ~50 canonical prompts (I'll upload them). If we see structured token shifts we need a fallback of the unquantized model for those routes. I'll own the eval harness.

maria-cs: Great — Jordan (Orbiton CSM) is on board for a small canary. Jordan, can you confirm internal stakeholders and a 1-2 hour window next week for the pilot?

jordan-orbiton: Happy to run this. We can do Tue 10am PT. I'll invite their infra lead. Need a short runbook so our SREs know the rollback toggle.

matt-eng: I'll prepare the routing policy and flag checks. Plan: 1) deploy quant variant to canary pool, 2) route 5% -> 20% over 30m if checks pass, 3) full stop if p95 > 350ms or spike in structured-output diff > 3%. Can you add the eval thresholds to the runbook @maria-cs?

ci-bot: canary deployment created: service=orbiton-llm, image=orbiton-model:q-int8-2026-03, routing_policy=hybrid-quant-micro-1, created_by=matt-eng

olivia-se: I'll drop the 50 canonical prompts and the smoke harness link in the ticket. Will also add deterministic sampling seeds to reduce variance.

maria-cs: Perfect. Next steps: (a) SE runs smoke eval + share results (b) Eng deploys canary and wires checks (c) CSM runs customer-facing preflight and confirms Tue 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and a 1-page runbook. :thumbsup:

matt-eng: On it. tagging ops for a quick watch during the canary.

jordan-orbiton: Thanks all — we appreciate the proactive ops help. We'll be ready Tue.

maria-cs: Closing loop here after smoke results. If anything flares, we'll flip the route and revert the canary.
